newsitem.title: USA: CPUC seeks natgas surcharge to fund public program.
newsitem.headline: CPUC seeks natgas surcharge to fund public program.

text.p: The California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) said Wednesday it will ask the state legislature to require all California natural gas customers to pay a non-bypassable surcharge to ensure funding of public programs.
The surcharge would allow continuation of energy efficiency, low-income assistance and reasearch programs, the regulatory agency said.
The CPUC stressed this surcharge would not be new since utility customers currently pay for the programs through bundled gas rates.
Legislation would require the costs for each program to be shown as a separate item on natural gas bills.
The CPUC said funding for the public purpose programs would be set at 1996 levels, consistent with what has already been done for public purpose programs associated with electric utilities.
